name: modifier-group
title: Modifier group
description: Options with rules for products and menus: required, pick one or up to N, price add-ons and a polite count of what is chosen.
docs: max 1 (the default) draws radios, anything more draws checkboxes that lock at the maximum; pass Infinity for no limit. min of 1 or more marks the group Required. Prices are in minor units. The message for a missing choice shows after the first change, or at once with invalid.
